articles.title: Why 'computing in space' is the world's next tech battleground
articles.titleCn: 为什么“太空计算”是下一个全球科技战场
articles.summary: As artificial intelligence and Earth-observation data grow exponentially, computing is beginning to move beyond terrestrial data centers into orbit. China is accelerating its push into space computing through system planning and technological breakthroughs, joining an increasingly competitive global race to build the next generation of space-based digital infrastructure.
articles.summaryCn: 随着人工智能对算力需求激增，中国正通过部署太空计算星座来应对地面数据中心的能耗与气候挑战，并推动全球竞争格局转变。

According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), data centers accounted for about 1.5% of global electricity {{2}} in 2024, with power demand expected to rise sharply as AI deployment accelerates. Rising electricity use, cooling costs and increasing exposure to climate-related {{3}} are prompting governments and technology companies to rethink where future computing {{4}} should be built.
paragraphs.cn: 随着创纪录的热浪席卷全球部分地区，人工智能热潮正面临另一项挑战：保持数据中心内高性能芯片足够冷却以持续运行。这一挑战远不止于季节性高温。随着人工智能模型变得更大、计算密集度更高，对计算能力的需求正以考验传统数据中心物理极限的速度增长。根据国际能源署的数据，2024年数据中心约占全球电力消耗的1.5%，随着人工智能部署加速，电力需求预计将急剧上升。不断增长的电力消耗、冷却成本以及日益增加的气候相关干扰风险，正促使各国政府和技术公司重新思考未来计算基础设施应建在哪里。

paragraphs.en: Translating this background into action, a multi-city layout is taking shape in China. Beijing serves as the anchor for research and development and standard setting through its new innovation center. Tianjin focuses on space-ground computing {{5}} and hardware development. Shanghai is building out the broader industrial {{6}}. Hangzhou leans into intelligent applications, anchored by the "Three-Body Computing Constellation," which has already been deployed in orbit.

paragraphs.en: Led by Zhejiang Lab (ZJ Lab), it aims to build a network of thousands of satellites with a total computing power of 1,000 peta operations per second. The {{7}} will enable real-time in-orbit data processing with intelligent {{8}}. Why move computing power into space? Traditional satellites act like "cameras that only take pictures": they collect raw data in orbit, beam it all down to ground stations and wait for Earth-based supercomputers to process it. Industry estimates suggest less than 10% of collected data ever gets used, with {{9}} running to hours or days.
paragraphs.cn: 由之江实验室牵头，该项目旨在构建一个由数千颗卫星组成的网络，总计算能力达到每秒1000千万亿次运算。该星座将利用智能有效载荷实现实时在轨数据处理。为什么要把计算能力送入太空？传统卫星就像“只拍照的相机”：它们在轨道上收集原始数据，将所有数据波束传回地面站，然后等待地球上的超级计算机进行处理。行业估计表明，收集到的数据中只有不到10%被实际使用，延迟长达数小时或数天。

paragraphs.en: Space computing flips the model. Satellites are equipped with {{10}} chips, onboard servers and storage, linked into constellations that can collect, analyze and decide in orbit, sending back only high-value results. According to industry insiders, space computing mainly comprises three operating models: "in-orbit processing of space-collected data," which processes data gathered in space on board and downlinks only high-value results; "space-based processing of ground-uploaded data," which leverages the advantages of space computing to process data uploaded from the ground and "integrated space-ground collaborative computing," which builds a global distributed computing network to achieve efficient {{11}} of space and terrestrial resources. Applications range from real-time wildfire and flood alerts to crop-stress tracking, illegal-fishing {{13}} in remote oceans and polar-ice monitoring – all without waiting for a downlink window.
paragraphs.cn: 太空计算颠覆了这一模式。卫星配备了抗辐射芯片、机载服务器和存储设备，连接成星座，可以在轨道上收集、分析并做出决策，只传回高价值的结果。据业内人士称，太空计算主要包括三种运行模式：“天基数据在轨处理”，即在轨处理太空收集的数据，仅下传高价值结果；“天基处理地上传数据”，即利用太空计算的优势处理从地面上传的数据；以及“天地协同计算”，即构建全球分布式计算网络，实现空间和地面资源的高效互补。带宽消耗可降低90%以上；响应时间从数小时缩短到数秒。应用范围从实时野火和洪水警报，到作物胁迫跟踪、偏远海域非法捕捞检测以及极地冰盖监测——所有这些都无需等待下传窗口。

Progress across computing, energy and communications is reinforcing the foundations of China's space-based intelligent infrastructure. On the computing front, the country is prioritizing constellation-scale in-orbit clusters and homegrown anti-radiation technologies. The Three-Body Computing Constellation serves as a reference case: the 12-satellite network, equipped with domestically produced space-borne AI servers, delivers a peak of 744 TOPS per satellite and 5 POPS in aggregate, with core components fully {{15}} through native aerospace-grade chips and tailored processes. On the energy front, efforts center on high-efficiency space power generation and radiative thermal management.
paragraphs.cn: 加速技术突破以强化太空智能基础设施。计算、能源和通信方面的进展正在巩固中国天基智能基础设施的基础。在计算方面，国家优先发展星座级在轨集群和国产抗辐射技术。三体计算星座是一个参考案例：这个由12颗卫星组成的网络，配备了国产星载AI服务器，每颗卫星峰值性能达744 TOPS，总计5 POPS，核心组件通过本土航天级芯片和定制工艺实现完全本地化。在能源方面，工作重点集中在高效太空发电和辐射热管理上。

paragraphs.en: Galactic Aerospace's Lingxi 03, China's first flat-stack satellite with flexible solar wings, illustrates the direction: the "flexible wings" are compact, lightweight and modular, easier to stow and per unit mass, larger in area to capture more solar energy. On the thermal side, the company has broken through in pump-driven fluid-loop heat {{16}}, technologies that Zhang Shijie, chief scientist at Galactic Aerospace, says will underpin high-power space computing payloads. On the communication front, the focus is on a regionally {{17}} architecture. With dense ground-station coverage domestically and selective nodes overseas, inter-satellite laser links have stabilized at 100 Gbps and satellite-to-ground laser tests have reached 120 Gbps, while round-trip latency within China and the Asia-Pacific is held at 30 to 50 milliseconds, sufficient for time-sensitive scenarios such as emergency communications, with core devices 100% domestically controlled, according to Xu Zifan, a prominent technology analyst and the deputy director of the Advanced Computing Research Office at the Electronics Research Institute, which is part of the China Center for Information Industry Development. In an aerial view, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket rises after launching from Vandenberg Space Force Base carrying 24 Starlink internet satellites in Pasadena, California, US, June 24, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 银河航天的灵犀03是中国首颗带有柔性太阳翼的平板式卫星，它指明了方向：“柔性翼”紧凑、轻便且模块化，更易于收纳，单位质量面积更大，可捕获更多太阳能。在热控方面，该公司在泵驱流体回路散热技术上取得突破，银河航天首席科学家张世杰表示，这些技术将为高功率太空计算有效载荷提供支撑。在通信方面，重点在于构建区域弹性架构。据知名技术分析师、中国电子信息产业发展研究院电子信息研究所先进计算研究室副主任徐子凡称，凭借国内密集的地面站覆盖和海外选择性节点，星间激光链路已稳定在100 Gbps，星地激光测试达到120 Gbps，而中国及亚太地区的往返延迟控制在30至50毫秒，足以满足应急通信等时间敏感场景，核心设备100%国产化。

paragraphs.en:
The global race intensifies
The global race is {{18}}. SpaceX has outlined a long-term vision of deploying up to one million low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites as orbital data centers, while the European Union is advancing its Space Data Center initiative. Russia is enhancing onboard computing capabilities for its Sfera constellation, and Japan is investing in in-orbit processing for Earth-observation satellites. Some recent studies estimate that the LEO region between 300 and 2,000 km could safely accommodate only around 175,000 satellites under current collision-avoidance assumptions. Meanwhile, under the International Telecommunication Union's spectrum filing framework, satellite operators generally have seven years to bring frequency filings into use, followed by phased deployment milestones for non-geostationary constellations.
paragraphs.cn: 全球竞赛正在加剧。SpaceX已勾勒出长期愿景，计划部署多达100万颗低地球轨道卫星作为轨道数据中心，而欧盟正在推进其太空数据中心计划。俄罗斯正在增强其Sfera星座的星载计算能力，日本则投资于地球观测卫星的在轨处理。一些近期研究估计，根据当前的碰撞规避假设，300至2000公里之间的低地球轨道区域只能安全容纳约17.5万颗卫星。与此同时，根据国际电信联盟的频谱申报框架，卫星运营商通常有七年时间将频率申报投入使用，随后是非静止轨道星座的分阶段部署里程碑。

paragraphs.en: As AI models become larger and Earth observation grows exponentially, the competition is no longer about who can launch more satellites, but who can process information first. The next frontier of the digital economy may therefore be measured not only by computing power on Earth, but also by intelligence deployed in orbit.
paragraphs.cn: 随着人工智能模型变得更大，地球观测数据呈指数级增长，竞争已不再是关于谁能发射更多卫星，而是谁能首先处理信息。因此，数字经济的下一个前沿可能不仅取决于地球上的计算能力，还取决于部署在轨道上的智能水平。

Beijing serves as the anchor for research and development and standard setting through its new innovation center. Tianjin focuses on space-ground computing integration and hardware development. Shanghai is building out the broader industrial ecosystem. Hangzhou leans into intelligent applications, anchored by the "Three-Body Computing Constellation," which has already been deployed in orbit. Led by Zhejiang Lab (ZJ Lab), it aims to build a network of thousands of satellites with a total computing power of 1,000 peta operations per second. The constellation will enable real-time in-orbit data processing with intelligent payloads.
Why move computing power into space?
Traditional satellites act like "cameras that only take pictures": they collect raw data in orbit, beam it all down to ground stations and wait for Earth-based supercomputers to process it. Industry estimates suggest less than 10% of collected data ever gets used, with latency running to hours or days.
Space computing flips the model. Satellites are equipped with radiation-hardened chips, onboard servers and storage, linked into constellations that can collect, analyze and decide in orbit, sending back only high-value results.
According to industry insiders, space computing mainly comprises three operating models: "in-orbit processing of space-collected data," which processes data gathered in space on board and downlinks only high-value results; "space-based processing of ground-uploaded data," which leverages the advantages of space computing to process data uploaded from the ground and "integrated space-ground collaborative computing," which builds a global distributed computing network to achieve efficient complementarity of space and terrestrial resources.
Bandwidth consumption can drop by more than 90%; response times shrink from hours to seconds. Applications range from real-time wildfire and flood alerts to crop-stress tracking, illegal-fishing detection in remote oceans and polar-ice monitoring – all without waiting for a downlink window.

Accelerating tech breakthroughs to fortify space intelligent infrastructure
Progress across computing, energy and communications is reinforcing the foundations of China's space-based intelligent infrastructure.
On the computing front, the country is prioritizing constellation-scale in-orbit clusters and homegrown anti-radiation technologies. Galactic Aerospace's Lingxi 03, China's first flat-stack satellite with flexible solar wings, illustrates the direction: the "flexible wings" are compact, lightweight and modular, easier to stow and per unit mass, larger in area to capture more solar energy. On the thermal side, the company has broken through in pump-driven fluid-loop heat dissipation, technologies that Zhang Shijie, chief scientist at Galactic Aerospace, says will underpin high-power space computing payloads.
On the communication front, the focus is on a regionally resilient architecture. In an aerial view, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket rises after launching from Vandenberg Space Force Base carrying 24 Starlink internet satellites in Pasadena, California, US, June 24, 2026. 
The global race intensifies
The global race is intensifying. SpaceX has outlined a long-term vision of deploying up to one million low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellites as orbital data centers, while the European Union is advancing its Space Data Center initiative. articles.title: Europe enduring record-breaking heatwave, health systems under strain
articles.titleCn: 欧洲遭遇创纪录热浪，医疗系统承压
articles.summary: Europe is experiencing an extremely severe heatwave that has swept across the continent, with scientists describing it as one of the worst recorded.
articles.summaryCn: 欧洲遭遇创纪录热浪，多国医疗系统面临巨大压力，基础设施受损，政府采取紧急措施应对。

paragraphs.en: Europe is experiencing an extremely severe {{0}} that has swept across the continent, with scientists describing it as one of the worst recorded. Health authorities across multiple countries have issued high-level {{2}} as extreme temperatures {{1}} hospitals, transport systems, {{13}} and public services, while governments have introduced emergency {{3}} such as alcohol limits, event cancellations and public safety measures. The UK recorded its hottest June day on record on Friday, with a {{7}} temperature of 37.3 degrees Celsius recorded in Santon Downham, Suffolk, surpassing a previous record of 36.7 degrees Celsius set just a day earlier in Merryfield, Somerset. Temperatures in parts of central and northern Italy are forecast to reach 38 to 40 degrees Celsius. Two powerful earthquakes that struck Venezuela within a minute of each other on June 24 were caused by movements along two interconnected fault systems at the boundary between the Caribbean and South American tectonic plates, according to experts.
According to the US Geological Survey, a magnitude-7.1 earthquake struck near Montalbán, Venezuela, on June 24, followed less than a minute later by a magnitude-7.5 quake. The magnitude of the first earthquake was later revised to 7.2.
Qu Guosheng, former chief engineer of the China Earthquake Emergency Search and Rescue Center, told China News Service that the first magnitude-7.2 earthquake occurred along the Central Range Fault, a thrust strike-slip fault at the eastern end of the Andes Mountains. The rupture propagated northeastward and subsequently triggered movement along the Boconó-San Sebastián-El Pilar fault system, an east-west trending strike-slip fault zone, resulting in the second earthquake.
Sergio Barrientos, director of the National Seismological Center at the University of Chile, said Caracas and surrounding areas have experienced several major earthquakes throughout history because the region lies along the boundary between the Caribbean and South American plates.
Barrientos noted that major earthquakes struck Caracas in 1812, 1900 and 1967. The relative movement of the Caribbean Plate against the South American Plate, which shifts by about two centimeters each year, gradually builds up stress in the Earth's crust. When the accumulated stress exceeds the strength of the rocks, the crust ruptures along the plate boundary, triggering earthquakes. He said the two recent earthquakes were caused by the same tectonic process.
Barrientos added that both earthquakes were shallow and occurred along near-vertical faults, allowing the movement between the tectonic plates to release substantial energy, contributing to significant casualties and property damage.
The two earthquakes, both exceeding magnitude 7, have raised concerns about whether the Earth is entering a period of heightened seismic activity. However, Barrientos said global statistics suggest earthquakes of this scale fall within the normal range of tectonic activity.
On average, one magnitude 8 or stronger earthquake occurs worldwide each year, he said. Statistically, each magnitude 8 earthquake is accompanied by about 10 magnitude 7 earthquakes, 100 magnitude 6 earthquakes and 1,000 magnitude 5 earthquakes over the same period. Barrientos said earthquakes of the size recorded in Venezuela are a normal geological phenomenon, particularly within the seismically active Pacific Ring of Fire and other tectonically active regions.

巴里恩托斯说，委内瑞拉记录到的这种规模的地震是一种正常的地质现象，尤其是在地震活跃的环太平洋火山带和其他构造活跃地区。

articles.fullText:
People line up to receive food donations from the United Nations World Food Programme in Damasak, northeastern Nigeria, October 6, 2024. /CFP
Hunger across conflict-affected northern Nigeria has reached its highest levels in nearly a decade, with more than 17 million people experiencing crisis, emergency or catastrophic food insecurity, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) warned on Thursday.
The agency said worsening insecurity, expanding armed violence and shrinking humanitarian funding are driving the crisis, as conflict spreads beyond the northeast into parts of northwestern Nigeria.
"What concerns us most is how this crisis is expanding," WFP Regional Director for West and Central Africa, Kinday Samba, said in a statement. He noted that growing insecurity is forcing people off their farmland, displacing communities and restricting humanitarian access.
Nigeria has battled a militant insurgency centered in the northeast since 2009, with violence intensifying again since 2025. Armed bandit groups have also expanded operations in the northwest, compounding the humanitarian crisis.
According to the WFP, the number of areas inaccessible to humanitarian workers has doubled, with 15 additional locations now considered only partially accessible because of insecurity.
The agency said the food security situation is deteriorating faster than previously anticipated. In Borno State, the epicenter of the insurgency, more than three million people are acutely food insecure, including around 10,000 facing catastrophic hunger.
Despite rising needs, humanitarian assistance is declining because of severe funding shortages. During the 2025 lean season, the WFP provided food and nutrition assistance to 1.3 million people. This year, it expects to reach just over half that number.
Across northeastern Nigeria, 6.2 million people are now food insecure, but the agency says it can assist only about 740,000 people, leaving roughly 5.5 million, many of them children, without food assistance.
The WFP warned that dwindling aid is forcing vulnerable households to adopt increasingly desperate coping strategies, including reports of some people joining armed groups in search of food or income.
The warning comes amid broader economic challenges in Nigeria, where rising poverty, inflation and conflict continue to strain livelihoods despite ongoing economic reforms.
